title.zh: FlClash 订阅自动更新与故障恢复：节点超时重测、备份订阅源与配置导出迁移
title.en: FlClash Automated Profile Refresh & Disaster Recovery: Timeout Retests, Backup Sources & Migration

description.zh: 保障出海业务连续性的 FlClash 高可用运维手册。教你配置订阅定时静默更新、节点超时自动化重测机制、双订阅主备故障转移及一键导出配置文件无缝跨机迁移实操。
description.en: Operational continuity and disaster recovery manual for FlClash. Learn how to configure scheduled silent profile updates, automated timeout retests, multi-subscription failover, and one-click profile exports for instant device migrations.
